title: The Broken Tide Mill
purpose: A 32 by 24 cell encounter map with two river crossings, a ruined mill and readable approach choices.

inspiration.premise: An abandoned tide mill controls a narrow watercourse; the bridge is exposed, while a shallow ford offers an alternate approach.

style.medium: Hand-painted fantasy encounter map with precise floor plans and restrained material texture.
style.linework: Clean dark boundaries for walls and water edges, softer marks for grass and worn earth.
style.surface_texture: Specific local wear and material grain; no uniform noise over all walkable spaces.
style.lighting: Even readable daylight, short soft shadows, no bloom or fog over movement paths.

environment.terrain_summary: A north-south watercourse divides grassy banks. The mill sits on the east bank. A stone bridge near the center and a shallow ford to the south both connect the west approach to the eastern terrace.

mill.name: The Tide Mill
mill.appearance: A roofless rectangular stone mill interior with broken walls, pale flagstones, one large grindstone and a dry work area. View every wall and floor vertically from above.
must_show: walls do not cover interior floor
must_avoid: a second floor drawn over the playable floor
mill.gameplay_role: Encounter objective with an enterable interior

waterwheels.name: Twin Waterwheels
waterwheels.appearance: Two large weathered wooden waterwheels attached to the mill west wall, readable from directly above with their axles pointing toward the mill.
waterwheels.gameplay_role: Distinctive industrial landmark and edge hazard

channel.name: The Millrace
channel.appearance: A continuous clear teal channel flowing from the north edge to the south edge, darker in the deeper center and shallow at the southern ford.

west_entry.name: West Approach
west_entry.appearance: A broad patch of dry packed earth with sparse grass and enough unoccupied floor for an arriving group.

bridge.name: The Stone Span
bridge.appearance: A short east-west stone bridge crossing the channel; its clear travel surface connects both banks. Low broken parapets provide partial cover without sealing the path.
must_show: at least two cells of clear width

ford.name: The Shallow Ford
ford.appearance: A shallow crossing of pale submerged stones with a readable line of travel across the channel, no deep-water gap.
must_show: at least three cells of passable width
visible shallows rather than a second bridge

east_terrace.name: The Work Terrace
east_terrace.appearance: An open paved work terrace on the east bank; broken edge stones frame the space but leave the central travel lane clear.
east_terrace.gameplay_role: Maneuvering and staging space before entering the mill

mill_entry.name: South Mill Doorway
mill_entry.appearance: A two-cell-wide opening in the south wall of the mill, without a door leaf or debris across the threshold.
must_show: an actual opening in the wall
mill_entry.gameplay_role: Access from the terrace to the mill interior

cover_blocks.name: Fallen Stone Blocks
cover_blocks.appearance: Three separate fallen sandstone blocks grouped along the eastern terrace edge, with gaps between them and no obstruction to the central approach.
cover_blocks.gameplay_role: Optional cover outside the central movement lane

hidden_cache.name: Hidden Axle Cache
hidden_cache.appearance: A concealed compartment beneath the workbench.
hidden_cache.gm_notes: A sealed note and a silver key are here. Neither the compartment outline nor its label belongs on the player map.

bridge_approach.appearance: A continuous dry approach across the bridge, with the road surface visible between pieces of rubble.

ford_approach.appearance: A continuous alternate approach through the shallow ford and back onto the eastern bank.

terrace_to_door.appearance: An unobstructed stone approach to the south doorway.

door_to_interior.appearance: An open threshold leading into the visible mill interior.

relationships.detail: The mill is on the east bank, with only the waterwheels approaching the water.
The bridge deck crosses the actual water, not merely points toward it.
The ford is the distinctly separate southern route.
Keep the main approach from the south.

affordances: cover placed away from the central lane

annotations.typography: No lettering on the player battlemap.

must_include: one stone bridge and one distinct shallow ford
production.revision_notes: Original tactical demonstration. Requested dimensions are a delivery target, not proof of native image output size.
